description: Small development-only retrieval set for testing curated terminology expansion after the frozen Bidāyat holdout exposed a candidate-recall failure for المضاربة targeting كتاب القراض. This dataset is intentionally contaminated by that diagnosis and must never be presented as an independent holdout.
label_provenance: All expected sections already exist in the stored Bidāyat corpus and are runtime validated. The المضاربة case was copied from the diagnosed holdout failure specifically to test candidate-generation recovery. These labels are retrieval-engineering artifacts, not scholarly legal judgments.
